mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.patient_no, p.name, p.gender, p.birthday, p.id_card, p.phone, p.address, p.disease_type, p.diagnosis_date, p.current_doctor_id, p.risk_level, p.status, u.name AS doctor_name, rlc.level_name AS risk_level_name FROM patient p LEFT JOIN doctor d ON p.current_doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN risk_level_config rlc ON p.risk_level = rlc.level_code WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient (patient_no, name, gender, birthday, id_card, phone, address, disease_type, diagnosis_date, current_doctor_id, risk_level, status) VALUES (#{patientNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{diseaseType}, #{diagnosisDate}, #{currentDoctorId}, #{riskLevel}, #{status})
